heroDescription: Therapeutic massage, herbal head spa and our Royal Herbal oriental therapies – in a calm, private space in the heart of Buon Ma Thuot.
heroImageAlt: Treatment room with a wooden soaking tub and white curtains at Mandala
pillarsTitle: Complete care, from body to mind
pillarsIntro: Four families of treatments – from gentle relaxation to focused therapy – so you can choose exactly what your body needs.

signature.title: Royal Herbal Line
signature.text: Inspired by the wellness rituals of Vietnam’s royal court, these treatments combine warm herbs, gentle heat and our herbal copper roller glided along the body’s meridians – warming you through, easing deep tension and leaving you relaxed from the inside out.
points: Warm herbal compresses that soothe tired muscles
Herb-filled copper roller along the shoulders and back
Ideal for long-standing aches and a body that feels chilled
signature.imageAlt: Therapist gliding a warm herbal copper roller across a guest’s shoulders
signature.secondAlt: Warm herbal soak with ginger, cinnamon and lemongrass

journey.title: Every visit to Mandala is a ritual of care
journey.imageAlt: A cup of warm ginger, cinnamon and lemongrass tea to welcome guests

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text: A cup of warm ginger, cinnamon and lemongrass tea helps you unwind the moment you arrive.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We listen to how you feel, where it aches and what you hope for, then suggest the right treatment.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.text: Let go in a quiet room with caring hands – the pressure is always up to you.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Relax with herbal tea so your body can fully recover before you head out.

promises.title: Wellness philosophy
promises.text: We focus on lasting wellbeing, not just a moment of relaxation.

promises.title: Private rooms
promises.text: Private treatment rooms with soft light, plus couple rooms for partners and families.

promises.title: Spotless hygiene
promises.text: Fresh towels and linen for every guest; tools cleaned after each treatment.

promises.title: Honest prices
promises.text: Clear, fixed prices with no hidden charges.

comboImageAlt: Couple treatment room with floor mattresses, lacquer art and bamboo lamps

space.title: A quiet escape from the busy streets
space.text: Warm earthy tones, woven bamboo lamps, Vietnamese lacquer art and the scent of herbs – every detail is designed to help you forget the world outside.
